findings.title: RACI Auditor path classification fails open for unrecognized paths
findings.notes: Introduced by v3.4 repair chain (TASK-1007). classify_path() now returns 'unknown' for unrecognized paths; RACI_MATRIX_V2 has no 'unknown' category → fail-closed VIOLATION. Mitigated by TASK-1007.

findings.title: Non-canonical agent identity aliases accepted without rejection in RACI audit
findings.notes: Introduced by v3.4 repair chain (TASK-1007). resolve_identity() in agent_identity.py raises AliasRejectedError for non-canonical aliases in strict mode (exit 2). Mitigated by TASK-1007. RT-ALIAS-CHAIN-001 confirmed.

findings.title: Path normalization bypass via Unicode homoglyph and dotdot traversal in classify_path()
findings.notes: Introduced by v3.4 repair chain. Unicode homoglyph (RT-PATH-001): BLOCKED — classify_path() returns 'unknown' for non-ASCII path separator, fail-closed. Dotdot traversal (RT-PATH-002): FAIL — classify_path() lacks os.path.normpath(); dotdot path 'artifacts/code/../docs/orchestration.md' classified as 'code' instead of 'workflow_contract_docs'. Symlink confusion (RT-SYMLINK-001): ESCALATED by design — realpath resolution absent. Dotdot and symlink gaps deferred to backlog (FIND-26, FIND-27). Status In-Progress until all sub-gaps resolved.

findings.title: Assurance level 'high' in artifact schema vocabulary allows silent misclassification
findings.notes: Introduced by v3.4 repair chain (TASK-1008). validate_assurance_level_strict() now rejects 'high' with explicit error. Historical TASK-964 artifact corrected to 'mvp'. Mitigated by TASK-1008.

findings.title: Assurance level mismatch between task.md and status.json silently permitted
findings.notes: Introduced by v3.4 repair chain (TASK-1008). guard_status_validator.py now performs mismatch check between task.md assurance_level and companion status.json. Mitigated by TASK-1008.

findings.title: Source/template contract drift in governance scripts
findings.notes: Introduced by v3.4 repair chain (TASK-1006). guard_contract_validator detects checksum mismatch for EXACT_SYNC_FILES (RT-SOURCE-TEMPLATE-001 PASS). Template mirror path classification correct (RT-RACI-COLLISION-001 PASS). Remaining for Mitigated: (1) CI exact-sync guard not implemented, (2) drift regression case not in test corpus. Both deferred. FIND-18 = In-Progress per v3.4 plan §4.1. finalized_by=TASK-1012.

findings.title: Verify evidence floor accepts narrative/keyword-stuffed assertions as structured evidence
findings.notes: Introduced by v3.4 repair chain (TASK-1009/TASK-1015). _check_strict_verify_floor() rejects narrative-only Build Guarantee and Evidence Refs sections (RT-VERIFY-STUFFING-001 PASS, TASK-1019). Strict enforcement applies to post-baseline new/modified verify artifacts. Historical unchanged artifacts remain advisory-only. Semantic completeness gap (FIND-25) and HITL validator gap (FIND-28) remain In-Progress. Status In-Progress until semantic validator and HITL validator are implemented.

findings.title: Historical limited-evidence artifact misclassified as production-grade evidence
findings.notes: Introduced by v3.4 repair chain (TASK-1008/TASK-1010). TASK-964 reclassified as mvp + limited evidence (historical limited evidence exception). is_historical_limited_evidence_exception() guard prevents retroactive upgrade. TASK-1010 production canonical drill created as separate artifact. Mitigated by TASK-1010.

findings.title: Task supersession uses informal free-text without validated schema
findings.notes: Introduced by v3.4 repair chain (TASK-1011). v3.4 plan §5.0 formalizes superseded_by schema with successor_task_id, decision_ref, superseded_at, scope, remaining_obligations. TASK-1001 reconciliation uses formal schema. Mitigated by TASK-1011.

findings.title: HITL structured attestation bypass via AI-authored narrative timestamp
findings.notes: Introduced by v3.4 repair chain (TASK-1022 design, TASK-1019 execution). RT-HITL-ATTESTATION-001 FAIL: guard_status_validator does not parse evidence_timestamp_source field; reviewer_id presence alone passes nominal check; exit 1 observed only due to unrelated schema failures. HITL attestation validator not implemented. Implementation deferred to backlog (FIND-28). Status In-Progress; full mitigation requires HITL validator implementing evidence_timestamp_source determinism check.

findings.title: Indirect injection through research snippets into governance workflow
findings.notes: Introduced by TASK-1021 (Prompt 0a). Policy layer: untrusted-by-default rule (Rule-1/3/4) in artifacts/code/TASK-1021.code.md. RT-INJECTION-004 (TASK-1019) PASS: RACI_MATRIX_V2 reads only workflow_constants.py; research artifact content cannot override governance authority. Runtime enforcement (structural guard at intake boundary) deferred to Prompt 1+ prompts; not implemented. Status In-Progress until runtime guard implemented. finalized_by=TASK-1012.

findings.title: Memory-bank cumulative authority poisoning
findings.notes: Introduced by TASK-1021 (Prompt 0a). Policy layer: source-ref-required authority rule (Rule-2/4). RT-MEMORY-POISON-001 (TASK-1019) PASS: .github/memory-bank/ files not read by RACI_MATRIX_V2 validator; narrative authority claims have no effect. Runtime enforcement deferred. Status In-Progress until runtime guard at memory-bank intake boundary implemented. finalized_by=TASK-1012.

findings.title: Threat inventory semantic corruption via duplicate finding IDs (no semantic validator)
findings.notes: RT-THREAT-SEMANTIC-001 ESCALATED_BY_DESIGN: no semantic validator for threat-findings JSON; json.loads() succeeds on duplicate finding_id entries; gap documented per design. Semantic validator not yet implemented. Deferred to backlog. next_task_id=TBD-allocated-on-execution.

findings.title: Path dotdot normalization absent in classify_path() prefix matching
findings.notes: RT-PATH-002 FAIL: classify_path() does not call os.path.normpath(); 'artifacts/code/../docs/orchestration.md' classified as 'code' instead of 'workflow_contract_docs'; Codex CLI passes RACI check for a docs file. Fix: add os.path.normpath() before prefix matching. Deferred to backlog per TASK-1019 hardening_note. next_task_id=TBD-allocated-on-execution.

findings.title: Symlink and realpath resolution absent in RACI path classification
findings.notes: RT-SYMLINK-001 ESCALATED by design: classify_path() uses lexical prefix matching only; no realpath resolution; symlink-like path 'artifacts/code/orchestration.md' classified as 'code' regardless of actual filesystem target. Architectural gap requiring realpath-aware audit policy. Deferred to backlog. next_task_id=TBD-allocated-on-execution.

findings.title: HITL attestation validator contract not implemented
findings.notes: RT-HITL-ATTESTATION-001 FAIL: guard_status_validator does not validate evidence_timestamp_source; AI-authored narrative timestamps pass nominal check. Implementation required: reject evidence_timestamp_source values matching AI-authored narrative patterns; require git-based or CI-based timestamp sources. Deferred to backlog. next_task_id=TBD-allocated-on-execution.

findings.title: validate_context_stack module emits stdout/stderr at import time
findings.notes: Introduced by v3.4 repair chain (TASK-1013). Import-time side-effects removed; explicit init function added with stream injection; unit test confirms clean import. Mitigated by TASK-1013.

findings.title: run_red_team_suite lacks per-case and per-suite timeout protection
findings.notes: Introduced by v3.4 repair chain (TASK-1014). Per-case timeout (default 60s) and per-suite timeout (default 600s) implemented. TIMEOUT case marking and CI failure on any TIMEOUT in strict run implemented. Mitigated by TASK-1014.

findings.title: Verify floor enforcement absent across historical verify corpus
findings.notes: Introduced by v3.4 repair chain (TASK-1015). verify-floor-baseline.v3.4.json snapshots 32 historical artifacts (advisory-only). Post-baseline new/modified artifacts enforced strict. --verify-floor-enforce passes with 0 strict failures as of TASK-1019. Mitigated by TASK-1015.

findings.title: Red-team adversarial case corpus lacked formal regression promotion pipeline
findings.notes: Introduced by v3.4 repair chain (TASK-1019). 9 of 12 cases promoted to regression corpus (regression_promoted=true). Execution results JSON serves as regression evidence corpus. Mitigated by TASK-1019.

findings.title: Governance repair plan version assertion drift enabling plan confusion
findings.notes: Introduced by v3.4 repair chain (TASK-1020). v3.3 plan had self-assertion drift (plan claimed v3.3 but contained v3.2-era assertions). v3.4 plan enforces consistent self-assertion; governance-repair-manifest.v3.4.json as authoritative task ID registry. Mitigated by TASK-1020.

findings.title: Governance manifest task ID allocation policy absent enabling silent ID collision
findings.notes: Introduced by v3.4 repair chain (TASK-1020). governance-repair-manifest.v3.4.json defines reserved_task_range (TASK-1005..TASK-1022), task_id_remapping policy, and execution_order as authoritative. Preflight confirmed all IDs unused before mutation. Hard-coded task ID checks replaced by manifest reads. Mitigated by TASK-1020.
